nodes.name: claude-code-review.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow ('Claude Code Review') triggered on pull request opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, and reopened events. Checks out the repository and runs anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 with the code-review plugin and inline-comment MCP tool authenticated via CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

nodes.name: claude.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow ('Claude Code') triggered when @claude is mentioned in issue comments, PR review comments, PR reviews, or issue titles and bodies. Checks out the repository and runs anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 with read access to contents, pull requests, issues, and CI actions.
